parts.q: Look at this picture from our school trip to Samarkand. ______ a group of students standing in front of Registan Square.
parts.explain: Bu «The photo shows» iborasi bo'lib, rasmda nima tasvirlanganini bildiradi. Matndagi «a group of students» dalili shu variantni talab qiladi.

wrong.The photo makes: «Makes» bu yerda ma'no jihatdan mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: Look at my holiday picture. ______ we can see some children playing football on the grass.
parts.explain: Bu rasmning oldingi qismini ko'rsatuvchi «In the foreground» iborasi. «playing football» oldingi planda sodir bo'lmoqda.

wrong.In the background: «Background» orqa planni bildiradi, bolalar esa oldingi planda.
wrong.At the top: «At the top» rasmdan tepa qismini bildiradi.

parts.q: This is a picture of our family in the mountains. ______ we can see high snowy peaks under the blue sky.
parts.explain: Bu orqa fanni tasvirlaydigan «In the background» iborasi. «snowy peaks» uzoqda, ya'ni orqa fonda joylashgan.

wrong.In the foreground: Qorli cho'qqilar oldingi planda bo'lishi mumkin emas.
wrong.On the left: Bu chap tomonni bildiradi, tog'lar esa fonda.

parts.q: Check out this nice picture of the Tashkent TV Tower. ______ you can see a bright red flag flying high.
parts.explain: Bu «In the top left corner» iborasi bo'lib, yuqori chap burchakni bildiradi.

wrong.In the bottom right corner: Bu pastki o'ng burchakni bildiradi, bayroq esa tepada.
wrong.At the bottom: «At the bottom» rasmning eng pastki qismi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of our school yard. ______ there are some white clouds flying in the sky.
parts.explain: Bu «At the top» iborasi bo'lib, osmon rasmining yuqori qismida joylashganini ko'rsatadi.

parts.q: In this classroom photo, ______ of the page you can see some school bags on the floor.
parts.explain: Bu pastki qismni bildiruvchi «At the bottom» iborasi. Sumkalar polda, ya'ni pastda turibdi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of a traditional Uzbek table. ______ there is a big plate of hot plov.
parts.explain: Bu markazni ko'rsatadigan «In the centre» iborasi. Palov lagani stolning o'rtasida turibdi.

parts.q: Look at this strange animal in the zoo. ______ a very small cat, but it's actually a baby lion!
parts.explain: Bu «It looks like» iborasi bo'lib, o'xshashlikni bildiradi. Undan keyin ot keladi («a very small cat»).

wrong.It looks as if: «As if» dan keyin gap kelishi kerak, bu yerda esa ot kelgan.

parts.q: Look at my sister in this photo. ______ very tired after her long piano practice.
parts.explain: Bu shaxsning holatini taxmin qiluvchi «She seems to be» iborasi.

parts.q: Look at the winner of the English competition. ______ very happy with her gold medal.
parts.explain: Bu «She's probably feeling» iborasi bo'lib, uning qanday his qilayotganini bildiradi.

wrong.She looks as if: Undan keyin fe'lli gap kelishi kerak.

parts.q: ______ they're feeling a bit cold, but maybe they are just tired from walking.
parts.phrase: I expect they're feeling ..., but maybe ...
parts.explain: Bu «I expect they're feeling» iborasi bo'lib, ehtimoliy holatni bildiradi.

parts.q: That man ______ be our new English teacher because he is wearing a suit and holding books.
parts.explain: Bu «It must be» iborasi bo'lib, mantiqiy ishonchni bildiradi («because he is holding books»).

wrong.can't: Kitob ko'tarib yurgan kishi o'qituvchi bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun «can't» xato.
wrong.might not: Bu shubhani bildiradi, dalillar esa aniq.

parts.q: That person ______ be a famous footballer because he is wearing heavy winter boots and a thick coat.
parts.explain: Bu «It can't be» iborasi bo'lib, mantiqqa ko'ra bu mumkin emasligini bildiradi.

wrong.must: Qishki kiyimdagi odam futbolchi bo'lishi aniq emas.

parts.q: ______ go to the cinema this evening? There is a very funny comedy on.
parts.explain: Taklif bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan «Shall we ...?» iborasi. Undan keyin fe'l keladi.

wrong.Do you fancy to: «Fancy» dan keyin fe'l «-ing» shaklida kelishi kerak.

parts.q: ______ meet outside the school gates at 3 o'clock after our last lesson.
parts.explain: Birgalikda harakat qilishga undaydigan «Let's ...» iborasi.

wrong.Shall: «Shall» so'zi yolg'iz o'zi bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.How about: Undan keyin fe'l «-ing» bilan kelishi kerak.

parts.q: ______ playing computer games together at my house this Saturday afternoon?
parts.explain: Taklif bildirish uchun «Do you fancy ...?» iborasi ishlatiladi va undan keyin fe'l «-ing» shaklini oladi («playing»).

wrong.Shall we: «Shall we» dan keyin «playing» emas, oddiy fe'l keladi.

parts.q: ______ going to the local cafe for an ice cream after our exams?
parts.explain: Taklif berish uchun «How about ...?» iborasi ishlatiladi, undan keyin «going» kelgan.

wrong.Why don't: «Why don't» dan keyin ega kelishi kerak («Why don't we»).

parts.q: It would ______ nice to have a picnic in the park if the weather is sunny.
parts.explain: Taklif bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan «It would be nice to ...» iborasi.

wrong.have: «It would have nice» grammatik jihatdan xato.

parts.q: We could ______ go to the new library if the park is too crowded today.
parts.explain: Muqobil taklif bildirish uchun «We could always ...» iborasi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: ______ we order some pizza instead of cooking dinner tonight?
parts.explain: Taklif beruvchi «Why don't we ...?» iborasi. «we» egasidan oldin keladi.

wrong.What about: «What about» dan keyin fe'lga «-ing» qo'shilishi kerak edi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of our school canteen. ______ the foreground, two students are eating lunch together.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «In the foreground» iborasini ishlatishni o'rgatadi. Rasmning oldingi qismini tasvirlash uchun «In» so'zi mos keladi.

parts.q: Look at the mountains in this picture. ______ the background, we can see some high snow peaks.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «In the background» iborasini ishlatishni o'rgatadi. Rasmning orqa fonini ko'rsatish uchun «In» so'zi kerak.

parts.q: Look at the corner of this classroom photo. ______ the top left corner, there is a clock on the wall.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «In the top left corner» iborasini o'rgatadi. Chap yuqori burchakni ko'rsatish uchun «In» so'zi mos keladi.

parts.q: Look at the desk in this picture. ______ the bottom right corner, a red school bag is sitting on the floor.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «In the bottom right corner» iborasini talab qiladi. O'ng pastki burchakni tasvirlash uchun «In» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Look at the wall in our classroom. ______ the top, there is a big banner with English words.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «At the top» iborasini o'rgatadi. Yuqori qismni ko'rsatish uchun «At» so'zi to'g'ri keladi.

parts.q: Look at this photograph of our street. ______ the bottom, some colorful autumn leaves are lying on the pavement.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «At the bottom» iborasini ishlatishni talab qiladi. Pastki qismni ko'rsatish uchun «At» so'zi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of my friends. ______ the left, Aziz is holding a football.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «On the left» iborasini o'rgatadi. Chap tomonni ko'rsatish uchun «On» so'zi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Look at this picture of my family. ______ the right, my sister is smiling at the camera.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «On the right» iborasini o'rgatadi. O'ng tomonni tasvirlash uchun «On» so'zi kerak.

parts.q: Look at the classroom picture. ______ the centre, our teacher is writing a new grammar rule on the board.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «In the centre» iborasini o'rgatadi. Markaziy qismni ko'rsatish uchun «In» so'zi to'g'ri keladi.

parts.q: Look at this blurry photo of a cat. It ______ like a small rabbit sitting in the grass.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «It looks like» iborasini talab qiladi. O'xshashlikni bildirish uchun «looks» fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Look at the children in the pool. It looks as if ______ having a fantastic time swimming.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «It looks as if they're» iborasini o'rgatadi. Holatni taxmin qilish uchun «they're» so'zi mos keladi.

parts.q: Look at our English teacher in this picture. She ______ to be very happy with our test results.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «She seems to be» iborasini talab qiladi. Ko'rinishni ifodalash uchun «seems» so'zi kerak.

parts.q: Look at the winning team captain. He's probably ______ very proud after holding the trophy.
parts.explain: Bu mashq his-tuyg'uni taxmin qilish uchun «feeling» so'zini talab qiladi.

parts.q: Look at the dark clouds in the sky. Judging ______ the weather, I'd say it is going to rain soon.
parts.explain: Bu mashq «Judging by» iborasini o'rgatadi. Asosga ko'ra fikr bildirish uchun «by» predlogi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Look at the students running. To me, they ______ as if they are late for their math lesson.
parts.phrase: To me, they look as if ...
parts.explain: Bu mashq «To me, they look as if» iborasini o'rgatadi. Fikr bildirish uchun «look» fe'li kerak.

parts.q:
Timur: ______ we visit the new water park this Sunday? 
Malika: Yes, that is a fantastic plan!
parts.explain: Bu «Shall we» taklif bildirish qolipi bo'lib, «visit the new water park» harakatiga taklif qilyapti.

wrong.Let: «Let» fe'ldan oldin «us» olmoshini talab qiladi, bu yerda esa to'g'ridan-to'g'ri egaga o'tgan.
wrong.Do: «Do» so'roq shakli uchun ishlatiladi, lekin bu qolipga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q:
Zarina: ______'s eat some hot samsa at the local café. 
Dilshod: Perfect, I am very hungry.
parts.explain: Bu «Let's» taklif bildirish qolipi bo'lib, «eat some hot samsa» harakatini birga bajarishga chaqiradi.

wrong.Shall: «Shall» ikkinchi shaxsga nisbatan «Shall we» tarzida keladi, «Let's» qisqartmasi bu yerda qulayroq.
wrong.Would: «Would» fe'li bu tuzilmadagi qolipga grammatik jihatdan mos tushmaydi.

parts.q:
Aziza: How ______ going to the city library after lessons? 
Bobur: I would love to read some new books.
parts.explain: Bu «How about» taklif qolipi bo'lib, «going to the city library» variantini muhokama qilishga undaydi.

wrong.if: «How if» so'z birikmasi bu ma'noda taklif bildirish uchun ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.to: «How to» usulni ko'rsatadi, lekin bu yerda taklif ma'nosi talab qilinadi.

parts.q:
Madina: What ______ visiting our cousins in Samarkand? 
Sardor: Good idea, we can eat great food there.
parts.explain: Bu «What about» taklif qolipi bo'lib, «visiting our cousins» fikrini bildirish uchun mos keladi.

wrong.else: «What else» boshqa narsa haqida so'raganda ishlatiladi, taklif bildirmaydi.
wrong.for: «What for» sababni so'raydi, taklif bildirish qolipiga kirmaydi.

parts.q:
Sanjar: We could ______ start a new art project together. 
Alisher: Great, let's buy some paints.
parts.explain: Bu «We could always» taklif qolipi bo'lib, «start a new art project» muqobil variantini taklif qiladi.

wrong.never: «Never» rad ma'nosini bildiradi, taklif qilish uchun ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.often: «Often» takrorlanishni bildiradi, lekin qolipda «always» so'zi ishlatiladi.

parts.q:
Shohruh: Why ______ we organize a school football match this Friday? 
Otabek: Great, I will ask our PE teacher.
parts.explain: Bu «Why don't we» taklif qolipi bo'lib, «organize a school football match» harakatiga chorlaydi.

wrong.aren't: «Why aren't we» fe'l bilan ishlatilganda mantiqqa to'g'ri kelmaydi.
wrong.haven't: «Why haven't we» o'tgan zamon natijasini bildiradi, taklif uchun emas.

parts.q:
Dilshod: Let ______ study for our math exam in the school library. 
Zarina: Perfect, we can help each other.
parts.explain: Bu «Let's» taklif qolipi bo'lib, birgalikda imtihonga tayyorlanishni bildiradi.

wrong.me: «Let me» o'ziga nisbatan ruxsat so'rash, birgalikdagi taklif emas.
wrong.him: «Let him» uchinchi shaxsga ruxsat berishni bildiradi.

parts.q:
Bobur: How about ______ to the local park after classes? 
Aziza: I would love to walk outside.
parts.explain: Bu «How about» qolipi bo'lib, «going to the local park» harakatini taklif qilmoqda.

wrong.go: «How about» iborasidan keyin fe'l «-ing» qo'shimchasi bilan keladi.

parts.q:
Sardor: What about ______ our grandparents this weekend? 
Madina: Good idea, we can eat tasty plov together.
parts.explain: Bu «What about» qolipi bo'lib, «visiting our grandparents» taklifini bildiradi.

wrong.visit: «What about» dan keyin fe'lga «-ing» qo'shilishi shart.
wrong.to visit: Infinitiv bu yerda grammatik xato hisoblanadi.

parts.q:
Anora: It would ______ nice to have a picnic in the school garden. 
Akmal: Yes, the flowers are blooming.
parts.explain: Bu «It would be nice to» taklif qolipi bo'lib, piknik qilish istagini bildiradi.

wrong.have: Qolipda «be» fe'li ishlatiladi («It would be nice»).

parts.q:
Otabek: Why ______ we play computer games together this Saturday? 
Shohruh: Yes, I am totally free then.
parts.explain: Bu «Why don't we» taklif qolipi bo'lib, birga o'yin o'ynashni taklif etmoqda.

parts.q:
Sevara: ______ we visit the history museum this afternoon? 
Kamola: That sounds like a brilliant idea!
parts.explain: Bu «Shall we» taklif qolipi bo'lib, muzeyga borish fikrini bildiradi.

wrong.Let: «Let» so'zidan keyin «we» emas, «'s» ishlatilishi kerak edi.

parts.q:
Aziz: Let's ______ a new English vocabulary game now. 
Madina: Awesome, I love word games.
parts.explain: Bu «Let's» taklif qolipi bo'lib, o'yin o'ynashga da'vat qiladi.

wrong.playing: «Let's» so'zidan keyin fe'l o'zining asosiy shaklida keladi.

parts.q:
Bobur: Do you fancy ______ ice cream in the park? 
Aziza: Yes, chocolate flavor is my favorite.
parts.explain: Bu «Do you fancy» taklif qolipi bo'lib, muzqaymoq yeyishni taklif qilmoqda.

wrong.eat: «Fancy» fe'lidan keyin fe'l «-ing» bilan kelishi kerak.

parts.q:
Nargiza: How about ______ a bike ride along the river? 
Jasur: Great, let's prepare our bicycles.
parts.explain: Bu «How about» qolipi bo'lib, velosipedda sayr qilishni taklif etadi.

wrong.have: «How about» iborasidan keyin fe'lga «-ing» qo'shilishi kerak.

topics.name: Describing a photo
topics.summary: Bu iboralar fotosuratdagi narsalar, odamlar va joylashuvni aniq ko'rsatish hamda tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: The photo shows — Suratda ... ko'rsatilgan. Umumiy mazmunni aytishda ishlatiladi.

example.en: The photo shows a family in a park.

usage.text: In the foreground — Oldingi planda. Suratning eng old qismidagi narsalarni tasvirlash uchun.

example.en: In the foreground, a boy is playing football.

usage.text: In the background — Orqa planda. Suratning uzoqdagi yoki orqa qismini ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: In the background, you can see mountains.

usage.text: In the top left corner — Yuqori chap burchakda. Joylashuvni aniq ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: In the top left corner, there is a bird.

usage.text: In the bottom right corner — Pastki o'ng burchakda. Suratning pastki o'ng qismini belgilash uchun.

example.en: In the bottom right corner, a dog is sleeping.

usage.text: At the top — Yuqorida. Suratning yuqori qismini tasvirlashda.

example.en: At the top, the sun is shining brightly.

usage.text: At the bottom — Pastda. Suratning eng pastki qismini ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: At the bottom, flowers are growing.

usage.text: On the left — Chap tomonda. Chap qismdagi obyektlar uchun.

example.en: On the left, a girl is reading a book.

usage.text: On the right — O'ng tomonda. O'ng qismdagi obyektlar uchun.

example.en: On the right, a car is parked.

usage.text: In the centre — Markazda. Suratning qoq o'rtasidagi narsani ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: In the centre, there is a big table.

usage.text: It looks like — ... ga o'xshaydi. Ko'rinishdan qandaydir holatni taxmin qilish uchun.

example.en: It looks like rain.

usage.text: It looks as if they're — Ular go'yo ... qilgandek ko'rinmoqda. Odamlarning harakatini tasvirlashda.

example.en: It looks as if they're enjoying the party.

usage.text: She seems to be — U ... ga o'xshaydi / ... qilganga o'xshaydi. Shaxsning holatini bildiradi.

example.en: She seems to be tired.

structure.formula: The photo shows + noun / noun phrase

example.en: The photo shows a group of friends.
In the foreground, a boy is smiling.
It looks like a wonderful holiday.

structure.formula: It looks as if + subject + verb

example.en: It looks as if they are winning the match.

topics.tip: Joylashuvni aytganda 'in the picture' yoki 'in the photo' deng, 'on the picture' deyish xato hisoblanadi.

topics.name: Speculating about a photo
topics.summary: Bu iboralar ko'rgan narsalarimizga asoslanib, odamlarning hissiyotlari va vaziyat haqida taxminlar bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: She's probably feeling — U ehtimol ... his qilayotgandir. Odamning hissiyotini taxmin qilish uchun.

example.en: She's probably feeling nervous before the test.

usage.text: I expect they're feeling ..., but maybe — Ular ... his qilayotgandir deb o'ylayman, lekin balki... Ziddiyatli taxminlar uchun.

example.en: I expect they're feeling happy, but maybe they are tired.
example.uz: Ular xursand deb o'ylayman, lekin balki charchagandirlar.

usage.text: Judging by ..., I'd say — ... ga qarab aytish mumkinki... Dalillarga tayanib fikr bildirish.

example.en: Judging by their clothes, I'd say it's winter.
example.uz: Ularning kiyimlariga qarab aytish mumkinki, qish.

usage.text: To me, they look as if — Menga ular ... degandek ko'rinadi. Shaxsiy fikr va taassurot.

example.en: To me, they look as if they are lost.

usage.text: It can't be ... because — Bu ... bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki... Mantiqiy rad etish.

example.en: It can't be hot because they are wearing coats.
example.uz: Issiq bo'lishi mumkin emas, chunki ular palto kiyib olishgan.

usage.text: It must be ... because — Bu ... bo'lishi kerak, chunki... Aniqlik darajasi yuqori bo'lgan taxmin.

example.en: It must be London because of the red bus.
example.uz: Qizil avtobus borligi uchun bu London bo'lishi kerak.

structure.formula: Subject + must be + noun/adjective + because + clause

example.en: It must be cold because of the snow.
example.uz: Qor borligi uchun sovuq bo'lishi kerak.

structure.formula: It can't be + noun/adjective + because + clause

example.en: It can't be summer because trees have no leaves.
example.uz: Daraxtlarda barg yo'qligi uchun yoz bo'lishi mumkin emas.

structure.formula: Judging by + noun, subject + would say / verb

example.en: Judging by her smile, she is happy.
example.uz: Uning jilmayishiga qarab, u xursand deb ayta olaman.

topics.tip: Aniq ishonmagan paytda 'must be' (aniq shunday) va 'can't be' (aniq unday emas) so'zlarini mantiqiy dalillar bilan ishlatishni unutmang.

topics.name: Making suggestions
topics.summary: Bu iboralar do'stlar bilan nima qilishni rejalashtirish va birgalikda biror ishni bajarishni taklif qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Shall we ...? — ... qilamizmi? Biror ishni birgalikda qilishni taklif qilish.

example.en: Shall we go to the cinema tonight?

usage.text: Let's ... — Kelin ... qilamiz. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri taklif bildirish.

example.en: Let's play computer games.

usage.text: Do you fancy ...? — ... qilishni xohlaysizmi? Istakni so'rash uchun V-ing shakli bilan ishlatiladi.

example.en: Do you fancy eating pizza?

usage.text: How / What about ...? — ... haqida nima deysiz? Fikr so'rash va taklif berish uchun V-ing bilan.

example.en: How about visiting our grandparents?

usage.text: It would be nice to ... — ... qilish yaxshi bo'lar edi. Yoqimli taklif kiritish.

example.en: It would be nice to have a picnic.

usage.text: We could always ... — Biz har doim ... qilishimiz mumkin. Muqobil variantni taklif qilish.

example.en: We could always watch a movie at home.
example.uz: Biz har doim uyda kino ko'rishimiz mumkin.

usage.text: Why don't we ...? — Nima uchun ... qilmaymiz? Savol shaklida taklif berish.

example.en: Why don't we start a band?
Shall we meet at 5 PM?
Let's do our homework together.
Do you fancy swimming?
What about buying some ice cream?
example.uz: Biroz muzqaymoq sotib olsak nima deysiz?

example.en: Why don't we ask the teacher?

topics.tip: 'Do you fancy' va 'How/What about' iboralaridan keyin fe'l doimo -ing qo'shimchasi bilan kelishini unutmang (masalan: Do you fancy going...).

mistakes.wrong: The photo shows on the right a boy.
mistakes.right: The photo shows a boy on the right.
mistakes.why: 'Show' fe'lidan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri obyekti kelishi kerak, joylashuv esa oxirida yoziladi.

mistakes.wrong: In the picture, she is looking sad.
mistakes.right: In the photo, she looks sad.
mistakes.why: Holatni bildiruvchi fe'llar ('look', 'seem') davomiy zamonda ('is looking') ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: It must be happy because she is smiling.
mistakes.right: She must be happy because she is smiling.
mistakes.why: Odamning hissiyotini aytganda 'It must be' emas, 'She must be' ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Do you fancy to go to the park?
mistakes.right: Do you fancy going to the park?
mistakes.why: 'Fancy' fe'lidan keyin fe'l 'to' bilan emas, -ing qo'shimchasi bilan keladi.

mistakes.wrong: What about go to the museum?
mistakes.right: What about going to the museum?
mistakes.why: 'What about' va 'How about' iboralaridan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shilishi shart.
'Let's' so'zidan keyin 'to' ishlatilmaydi, faqat fe'lning o'zi keladi.
Savol tuzishda 'Why' dan keyin darhol yordamchi fe'l 'don't' kelishi kerak.
